design.decision: A 9 bid compounds the whole score, and a set compounds too. It is the clearest gamble in the pool.
design.opponent: Shown after bidding. Opponents know a set swings the scores hard.
design.rationale: This fits the common budget of '×1.5 on a narrow condition', and the narrow condition here is the bid itself. It is a common ×mult that stays under the ceiling through rarity of firing, not a rider.
design.draftText: ×1.5 contract multiplier when your team bids 9 or more

critic.concerns: Threshold and category near-duplicate of seed-bid8-mult and seed-bid10-mult; a clear, visible gamble.

text: ×1.5 contract multiplier when your team bids 9 or more
